versions.content: Fibex compatibility Type: valid Description: Whenever there is a considerable overlap between the System Template and the ASAM FIBEX Standard, the System Template shall adopt the structures of the ASAM FIBEX Standard. Rationale: The System Template will benefit from FIBEX as an established proven standard. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Facilitate the adoption of the System Template into existing tools which deal with the FIBEX Standard. Supporting Material: ASAM FIBEX
